north_star: Go beyond matched positive/negative order-discrimination to directly predict a genuinely future raw observation property from previously seen four-channel bytes. No future feature access.
hypothesis: A fixed-width causal ordered-lag representation may transfer from affine/quadratic development generators to never-trained xorshift next-delta signs, unlike unordered histogram controls.
freeze: Freeze all generator families, splits, time windows, binary labeling, model width, training budget, controls and success thresholds before first-use. Never tune against xorshift heldout.
training: For each development seed, nine entities and t in [4..14], sample W-R20 affine and quadratic generators, each observed through four-channel offset+17 and genuine per-tick noise amp1 and amp2. Label +1 if raw unobserved future first-channel circular delta `(base[t+1][0]-base[t][0])%256` is in [0..127], otherwise -1. Features use candidate observations at t-4 through t ONLY.
heldout: For heldout 400..415, three generators affine/quadratic/xorshift, same 9 entities and t in [4..14], offset+79 and true per-tick noise amp3, no target future observation in feature.
representations: ordered_lag_deltas: 16 features, four modulo256 signed normalized differences over four consecutive past ticks for each of four channels
unordered_histogram: 16 bins of first-channel last-five observed values modulo16
current_four_channels_repeated: 16 features repeating four current observed channel values
learners: Three 16-weight+bias perceptrons, zero initialization, 32 fixed epochs, LR0.1, identical 16*9*11*2*2=6336 labeled development examples/model, no model calls. Also evaluator-only majority label baseline using development label distribution, no extra learned weights.
outcome: RAW_NEXT_STEP_TRANSFER if ordered_lag_deltas heldout accuracy>=0.65 on BOTH quadratic and xorshift, exceeds histogram by>=0.05 on xorshift, and exceeds majority label baseline on xorshift; PARTIAL if ordered beats histogram by>=0.03 on xorshift but fails strict transfer; NEGATIVE otherwise. Retain per-seed confusion and generator label balances.
controls: Assert features t-4..t only, no label/oracle target t+1 reading except evaluator
Development and heldout disjoint, no xorshift in model fitting
Equal per-model data, width, epochs, exactly one original first-use artifact then full Go regression
No hidden capacity increase, accepted-ref mutation, production activation or posthoc tuning
claim_limit: Binary next-delta prediction from deterministic synthetic raw streams, not generalized reasoning or real language.
